title: Admin Gateway Skill Input
description: Common input shape for any Skill under .harness/skills/. Each Skill declares its own additionalProperties schema in its SKILL.md frontmatter.

skill.description: Which Skill to invoke (must match the directory under .harness/skills/).

dry_run.description: If true, report what would be done without making changes.

since.description: Optional ISO-8601 timestamp; Skills that read logs use this as the lower bound.

window.description: Optional relative window for log-reading Skills (e.g. '24h', '7d').
